test_cases.name: review_import_style
assertions: Notes that types are correctly imported and used unqualified
Suggests checking for local trait imports if any traits were used

test_cases.name: design_api_error_handling
test_cases.input: Design a library function that looks up a user by ID. Should it return Option, Result, or panic? Follow Google Rust style.
assertions: Recommends Option for obvious missing case or Result for recoverable errors with context
Notes that panic is for violated invariants
Distinguishes library code (binding rules) vs application

test_cases.name: naming_and_docs
test_cases.input: Write a public function that converts a string to a custom Id type. Follow Google naming and documentation rules.
assertions: Uses from_ or try_new naming with From impl if appropriate
Includes /// doc comment documenting behavior and any panics

test_cases.name: unsafe_justification
test_cases.input: Is this unsafe block acceptable under Google Rust style? unsafe { ptr.read() }
assertions: Requires SAFETY: comment and justification why no safe alternative
